rules: Input snapshots are exact ordinary semantic_input.v1. Observer, expected axes, merge relations and reference-case expected answers are test sidecars; never feed expected labels/relations to a learned head as predictive features.

For merge-only contract tests, supplying source-grounded immutable rows/edges intentionally isolates the algebra. End-to-end tests must derive them from actual detector/parser and report this different denominator.
Same-turn component update map in R13 is deterministic decoder fixture input; in a full-pipeline test derive the update from actual current source evidence, never from expected_answer.
Synthetic verified observer proves only fixture dependence. Unqualified live/raw ingress remains closed and every wire decision abstains even on successful reference eligibility.

Current bundle capability flags are all false. A neutral fallback satisfies no-authority checks but counts not_exercised for expected semantic/detector outputs, never a successful semantic interpretation.
Meaning-only controls S01..S08 may remain unresolved until their scoped capability exists. Do not add or train new heads to inflate this smoke count; preserve unknown scope and masks.
All fixed numerals/identifiers in vectors are fictional engineering constants, not generic model/policy rules, final-brief values or public-test patches.

lineage_family groups related engineering cases; it is not a claim of statistically independent source roots. Reused source witnesses/variants retain ancestry. Do not use these diagnostics for qualification or rename them fresh TRAIN gold.
No expected bank write, consent grant, identity verification, transfer, close, refusal action or mutable state patch in this bundle. Values in merge expectations are descriptive facts only.
Run production-independent schema validator on actual outputs and record exact implementation/bundle/adapter hashes. Do not substitute the included schema example for candidate output.
